title: Predicates and Quantifiers
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of predicates and quantifiers using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates predicates and quantifiers.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Predicates and Quantifiers** as part of **Functional Programming and Idiomatic Kotlin**. Apply predicates and quantifiers by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—any and all, none and count, first , find , and Their Alternatives—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
